{{About|a [[Sword]]|the [[Sea Creature]]|Ragnarok|the Honk and Seek item|Ragna Rock}} {{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = r |damage = +200 |strength = +100 |gemstone_slots = *1 Combat |type = [[Sword]] |id = RAGNAROCK_AXE |sell = 5000 |enchantable = y |reforgeable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 6 |museum_category = combat |combat_level_requirement = {{Skill|Combat|22}} |raw_materials = *20 Hallowed Skull *1 Stick |mat_cost_bazaar = *20 Hallowed Skull |bazaar_not_including = 1 Stick }} The '''Ragnarock''' is a {{Rare}} [[Sword]]. == Obtaining == === Mob Drops === {{Drop Sources}} === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |B1 = Hallowed Skull, 10 |B2 = Hallowed Skull, 10 |B3 = Stick |Output = Ragnarock }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Ragnarock |rarity = r |damage = 200 |strength = 100 |item_ability_name = Ragnarock |item_ability_description = Begin a channel.
After not taking damage for {{Green|3s}}, gain {{Green|1.5x}} this weapon's {{Stat|strength}} for {{Green|10s}}. |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_mana_cost = 500 |item_ability_cooldown = 20s |item_ability_stats = Strength }} == Essence Crafting == {{Essence Crafting |100 Essence; 2 Hallowed Skull; 1 Spell Powder |250 Essence; 4 Hallowed Skull; 2 Spell Powder |500 Essence; 6 Hallowed Skull; 3 Spell Powder |1000 Essence; 8 Hallowed Skull; 4 Spell Powder |1500 Essence; 10 Hallowed Skull; 5 Spell Powder |2000 Essence; 12 Hallowed Skull; 6 Spell Powder |3000 Essence; 14 Hallowed Skull; 7 Spell Powder |4000 Essence; 16 Hallowed Skull; 8 Spell Powder; 3 Heavy Pearl |5000 Essence; 18 Hallowed Skull; 9 Spell Powder; 4 Heavy Pearl |6000 Essence; 20 Hallowed Skull; 10 Spell Powder; 5 Heavy Pearl |essence = Crimson |type = weapon }} == Tips == *The '''Ragnarock'''{{'}}s ability depends on its {{Stat|Strength}}, therefore the {{Ref|Withered}} reforge, {{Item|Hot Potato Book|text=Hot}} and {{Item|Fuming Potato Book}}s, {{Item|The Art of War}} and {{Item|Perfect Jasper Gemstone}} are recommended to fully utilize this item's ability. **This item's ability also pairs very well with a {{Item|Golden Dragon Pet}} combined with the {{EnchantmentLink|Chimera}} enchant, increase the {{Stat|strength}} gained. *It is not very useful to stay out of the battle just to be able to activate this ability. It is much better utilized before the start of fights (such as before an {{MobSprite|Ender Dragon}} or {{MobSprite|End Stone Protector}} spawn) or during phases when an enemy cannot be damaged and cannot damage the player to cancel the ability, for example during Slayers or between phases of {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} or {{MobSprite|Ashfang}}. **Namely it can be used during the [[Inferno Demonlord]] boss fight's Demonsplit phase to deal a large amount damage to {{MobSprite|Quazii}} and {{MobSprite|Typhoeus}}. **It can also be used during the [[Voidgloom Seraph]] boss fight's Broken Heart Radiation phase to increase damage right after the phase ends. *Switching one's held item before the ability activates will cancel the ability. However, switching items after the ability activated will maintain the {{Stat|str}} bonus. == Trivia == *Falling into the void does not count as taking damage for the purposes of the ability. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Feb 22|link=none|[[File:Ragnarock Axe.png|26px]] Added '''Ragnarock Axe'''.}} {{History|2025/Jun 5|[[File:Ragnarock (v1).png|26px]] Changed item model from an axe to a sword.|Renamed '''Ragnarock Axe''' to '''Ragnarock'''.}} {{History|2025/Oct 10 |
